description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, a implementation of the LogNode interface that filters log messages to only pass the message content downstream, removing metadata like tags or priority. It is used in logging systems to simplify on-screen log display.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that implements LogNode to pass only log messages, ignoring metadata for cleaner display.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message; passes only the message content to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
